defects.justification: aiohttp>=3.9 is an open lower bound; it admits aiohttp releases with known CVEs fixed later and any future major version.
pytest>=7 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
pytest-aiohttp>=1.0 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
The tests import pytest_asyncio and use pytest.mark.asyncio, but pytest-asyncio is not declared; it is only pulled in transitively by pytest-aiohttp.

Rooms are created on any join and never removed, and a single unauthenticated connection can join unlimited distinct room names, so the rooms dict (each with up to 50 x 2000-char history) grows without bound.

The sender's handler awaits asyncio.gather of send_json to every recipient with no timeout or per-client queue, so one recipient that stops reading (TCP backpressure) stalls the sender and every other poster in that room.
